import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, signal, subprocess, sys, time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
java = str(pathlib.Path.home() / '.sdkman/candidates/java/27.0.0-amzn/bin/java')
tools = str(repo / 'surprising-aeron-core/surprising-aeron-tools/target/surprising-aeron-tools.jar')
bench = str(repo / 'surprising-aeron-core/surprising-aeron-benchmarks/target/product-core-benchmarks.jar')
launcher = str(repo / 'scripts/start-product-line-providers.sh')
base = dict(os.environ, JAVA_HOME=str(pathlib.Path(java).parent.parent),
    RUNTIME_ROOT=str(root / 'runtime'), POSTGRES_HOST='127.0.0.1', POSTGRES_PORT='15432',
    POSTGRES_DB='sixline_live', POSTGRES_USER='sixline_qa', POSTGRES_PASSWORD='qa', POSTGRES_MODE='native',
    KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS='127.0.0.1:19092', VALKEY_HOST='127.0.0.1', VALKEY_PORT='16379',
    AERON_CLUSTER_HOSTNAMES='127.0.0.1', AERON_EGRESS_HOSTNAME='127.0.0.1',
    JVM_XMS='256m', JVM_XMX='512m', JFR_ENABLED='false', BUILD_CHANGED='false',
    SIX_LINE_LIVE_JDBC_URL='jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:15432/sixline_live',
    SIX_LINE_LIVE_JDBC_USER='sixline_qa', SIX_LINE_LIVE_JDBC_PASSWORD='qa',
    SIX_LINE_LIVE_TRADING='true', SIX_LINE_LIVE_EXPIRY='true', SIX_LINE_LIVE_OPTION_REFERENCE='true')
report = {'base_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
          'products': [], 'passed': False, 'wallet': False}
target = root / 'products.json'
resume = '--resume' in sys.argv
if resume:
    report = json.loads(target.read_text())
def save(): target.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
def run(name, args, env, directory, timeout=600, check=True):
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log = directory / (name + '-' + str(len(current['steps'])) + '.log')
    started = time.monotonic()
    print(f'START {directory.name} {name}', flush=True)
    with log.open('wb') as out:
        completed = subprocess.run(args, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
    content = log.read_text(errors='replace')
    step = {'name': name, 'log': str(log.relative_to(root)), 'command': args, 'exit_code': completed.returncode,
            'seconds': round(time.monotonic()-started,3), 'log_sha256': hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    current['steps'].append(step)
    save()
    print(f'END {directory.name} {name} exit={completed.returncode}', flush=True)
    if check and completed.returncode: raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed; {log}')
    return content
def tool(name, main, env, directory, extra=(), jar=tools):
    return run(name, [java, '--add-opens=java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED',
            '-Dsurprising.aeron.product-line='+env['PRODUCT_LINE'], '-Dsurprising.aeron.hostnames=127.0.0.1',
            '-Dsurprising.aeron.egress-hostname=127.0.0.1', *extra, '-cp', jar, main], env, directory, 120)
def helper(name, mode, path, env, directory, check=True):
    return run(name, [java, '--add-opens=java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED', '-cp', tools,
            str(root/'RuntimeCheck.java'), mode, str(path)], env, directory, 60, check)
def action(mode, env, directory, core=False):
    return run(('core-' if core else '')+mode, ['bash',launcher], dict(env,ACTION=mode,CORE_ONLY=str(core).lower()), directory)
def probe(name, env, directory):
    output = tool(name, 'com.surprising.aeron.tools.diagnostics.ClusterProbeMain', env, directory)
    match = re.search(r'status=OK appliedCommandCount=(\d+) stateHash=([0-9a-f]{16})',output)
    if not match: raise RuntimeError('missing successful state probe '+output[-1000:])
    return {'commands': int(match[1]), 'hash': match[2]}
def stop_http(env, directory):
    pid_dir = pathlib.Path(env['RUNTIME_ROOT']) / env['RUN_ID'] / 'pids'
    for name in ('maker','price','derivatives-lifecycle','gateway','realtime'):
        pid_path = pid_dir / (name+'.pid')
        if not pid_path.exists(): continue
        pid = int(pid_path.read_text().strip())
        identity = subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','command='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
        if '-Dsurprising.launcher.identity='+env['RUN_ID']+'/'+name not in identity:
            raise RuntimeError('process ownership mismatch '+name)
        label_path = pid_dir / (name+'.label')
        label = label_path.read_text().strip()
        run('stop-'+name, ['/bin/launchctl','remove',label],env,directory,60)
        deadline = time.monotonic()+30
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            status = subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','stat='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
            if not status or status.startswith('Z'): break
            time.sleep(.2)
        else: raise RuntimeError('HTTP process did not stop '+name)
        pid_path.unlink(); label_path.unlink()
def recover(env, directory):
    data = pathlib.Path(env['RUNTIME_ROOT']) / env['RUN_ID'] / 'aeron' / env['PRODUCT_LINE'].lower() / 'node0/cluster'
    checkpoint = current.get('recovery_checkpoint')
    if checkpoint and checkpoint['run_id']==env['RUN_ID']:
        before, first, last = checkpoint['before'], checkpoint['snapshots_before'], checkpoint['snapshots_after']
    else:
        before = probe('before-snapshot',env,directory)
        counts = helper('recordings-before','recordings',data,env,directory)
        run('snapshot',[java,'--add-opens=java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED','-cp',tools,
                'io.aeron.cluster.ClusterTool',str(data),'snapshot'],env,directory,60)
        first = dict(re.findall(r'SNAPSHOT_COUNT service=(-?\d+) count=(\d+)',counts))
        for attempt in range(12):
            after = helper('recordings-after-'+str(attempt),'recordings',data,env,directory)
            last = dict(re.findall(r'SNAPSHOT_COUNT service=(-?\d+) count=(\d+)',after))
            if all(int(last.get(s,-1))==int(first[s])+1 for s in ('0','-1')): break
            time.sleep(1)
        else: raise RuntimeError('service/consensus snapshot records did not advance')
        after_snapshot = probe('after-snapshot',env,directory)
        if before != after_snapshot: raise RuntimeError('snapshot changed command count or business hash')
        current['recovery_checkpoint']={'run_id':env['RUN_ID'],'before':before,'snapshots_before':first,'snapshots_after':last}
        save()
        action('down',env,directory,True)
    driver = env['CORE_AERON_BASE_DIR']+'-surprising-'+env['PRODUCT_LINE'].lower()+'-0'
    for attempt in range(12):
        status = helper('old-driver-'+str(attempt),'driver',driver,env,directory,False)
        if 'DRIVER_INACTIVE' in status: break
        time.sleep(1)
    else: raise RuntimeError('old MediaDriver remains active')
    action('up',dict(env,CORE_EXPECTED_STATE_HASH=before['hash']),directory,True)
    restored = probe('restored',env,directory)
    if restored != before: raise RuntimeError('cold recovery mismatch')
    current.setdefault('recoveries',[]).append({'run_id':env['RUN_ID'], 'before':before,'restored':restored,'snapshots_before':first,'snapshots_after':last})
    current.pop('recovery_checkpoint',None)
    save()

products = [x for x in sys.argv[1:] if x != '--resume'] or ['SPOT','LINEAR_PERPETUAL','INVERSE_PERPETUAL','LINEAR_DELIVERY','INVERSE_DELIVERY','OPTION']
for product in products:
    if product not in ('SPOT','LINEAR_PERPETUAL','INVERSE_PERPETUAL','LINEAR_DELIVERY','INVERSE_DELIVERY','OPTION'): raise ValueError(product)
    current = next((p for p in report['products'] if p['product']==product),None) if resume else None
    if current and current['passed']: continue
    if current is None:
        current = {'product': product, 'steps': [], 'passed': False}
        report['products'].append(current)
    if 'error' in current: current.setdefault('attempt_errors',[]).append(current.pop('error'))
    save()
    directory = root / 'evidence' / product
    env = dict(base, PRODUCT_LINE=product, RUN_ID='r72-'+product.lower().replace('_','-'),
        CORE_AERON_BASE_DIR=str(root/'core'), APP_AERON_DIR=str(root/'app'), SIX_LINE_LIVE_PRODUCT=product)
    env['SIX_LINE_LIVE_RUN_ID'] = env['RUN_ID']
    if product=='SPOT': env.update(SIX_LINE_LIVE_USER_HISTORY='true',SIX_LINE_LIVE_USER_FILLS='true')
    if product=='OPTION': env['SIX_LINE_LIVE_TRIGGER_READ_VIEW']='true'
    try:
        if current.get('live') != {'tests':1,'failures':0,'errors':0,'skipped':0}:
            run('isolate-product',['/usr/local/opt/postgresql@18/bin/psql','-h','127.0.0.1','-p','15432','-U','sixline_qa','-d','sixline_live',
                '-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-c',"UPDATE gateway_product_lines SET enabled=false, version=version+1, reason='round72 isolated verification';"],env,directory)
            action('up',env,directory)
            output = run('live',['mvn','-pl','surprising-gateway','-am','-Dtest=SixProductLineContractLiveTest','-Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false','test'],env,directory)
            xml = repo / 'surprising-gateway/target/surefire-reports/TEST-com.surprising.gateway.provider.local.SixProductLineContractLiveTest.xml'
            suite = ET.parse(xml).getroot()
